name: What should I prepare before meeting with a kitchen remodeling contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting with a kitchen remodeling contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by deciding how you use your space and noting current pain points, such as insufficient prep area or poor lighting. Measure your rough room dimensions and inventory your small appliances to determine needed storage. Establish a realistic budget range that accounts for labor, finishes, and unexpected structural repairs. Finally, gather visual references for cabinet styles and countertop materials so your design team understands your aesthetic preferences before drafting construction plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Outline your functional pain points, determine a budget range, collect design photos, and list must-have features or appliances before your initial consultation.
